svg.title: CHRONA Batch 4 — Timer & Stopwatch Contact Sheet
svg.desc: Complete 3x3 visual overview of all 5 Timer screens and 4 Stopwatch screens on 412x915dp AMOLED artboards.
svg.text: CHRONA Batch 4 — Timer & Stopwatch Contact Sheet
9 Artboards · 412 × 915dp AMOLED Grid · Circular Progress Ring (Timer) vs Precision 60-Tick Chronograph (Stopwatch)

g.title: CHRONA — Timer Home (Empty & Presets)
g.desc: Zeroed circular timer visualization with 1m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, and 30m presets, custom timer option, and Add timer CTA.

g.text: Select a quick preset or custom duration

g.title: CHRONA — Timer Setup
g.desc: Hours, minutes, and seconds numeric input with timer label, sound selection, and Start CTA.

g.title: CHRONA — Active Countdown Timer
g.desc: Large circular progress ring with dominant remaining time display and non-competing Pause, Resume, Stop, and Reset controls.

g.title: CHRONA — Multiple Concurrent Timers
g.desc: Three independent timer cards with unique labels, circular progress rings, remaining times, and individual pause/resume/stop controls.

g.title: CHRONA — Full-Screen Timer Completion
g.desc: Immersive AMOLED timer finished screen with timer name, zeroed readout, Repeat, and Dismiss controls.

g.title: CHRONA — Stopwatch Idle State
g.desc: Tick-marked precision stopwatch dial at 00:00.00 with enabled Start button and disabled Reset button.

g.text: Tap Start to begin timing · Tap Lap to record splits

g.title: CHRONA — Stopwatch Running State
g.desc: Live running stopwatch with 60-tick chronograph ring, live lap splits, Lap button, and Pause button.

g.title: CHRONA — Stopwatch Paused State
g.desc: Frozen elapsed time with Reset enabled, Resume primary pill CTA, and recorded lap list.

g.title: CHRONA — Stopwatch Lap History
g.desc: Expanded lap history list with restrained accent highlighting for Fastest and Slowest laps.
